decision_conditions: This decision relates solely to the partial discharge of Condition 14 part (ii) (Car Parking Management Strategy) attached to planning permission 2082/APP/2023/516. Condition 14 part (i) (Community Use Agreement) remains outstanding and must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the operation of community use activities.
